questions.question: What does Ezra 2 mostly consist of?
options: An account of a great battle fought in Babylon
A long prayer of confession and of much joyful praise
A list of the exiles who returned with Zerubbabel
A detailed code of laws for the restored nation
questions.answer: A list of the exiles who returned with Zerubbabel

questions.question: What were some priests excluded from until a priest with Urim and Thummim could decide?
options: The priesthood, because their genealogy was not found
Traveling beyond the city until they registered
Building the temple until they were approved
Eating the holy food until they were cleansed
questions.answer: The priesthood, because their genealogy was not found
